notes: Sheet is drawn north-up, so Bates Alley runs horizontally along the bottom; Cormany Av and Vermont Av appear only as stubs from sheet 287/289 and both end at Bates Alley (the alley's north line is continuous). ANDERSON is printed without a suffix and is written 'Anderson Street'. W. McMicken Av is printed (NOT OPEN) on both legs. Howell Av: only a strip between the 'SEE VOLUME SIX' boundary line (y~1100-1140) and block 2's north line (y~1196-1238) is drawn, labelled HOWELL AV. and 15'; it starts at Anderson (block 3 west of Anderson runs up to the boundary line). The Howell points use the centre of that strip; if the 15 ft strip is only the south part of a wider Howell Av whose remainder is in Volume 6, the true centreline would be further north (up by roughly half the extra width). The rest of the sheet west of the canal is the House of Refuge / City Work House grounds (sheet 294), with no streets; the narrow strip on the right beyond the binding (x>6400) belongs to another page and is ignored.
